title: Modrý kabát
topic: Zuzana goes shopping for a blue winter coat, but the coats are too expensive or too big, and her boyfriend Marek leaves with new clothes instead

sentences.sk: V sobotu idú Zuzana a Marek do obchodu s oblečením.
sentences.en: On Saturday Zuzana and Marek go to a clothing store.

sentences.sk: Zuzana potrebuje nový kabát, lebo ten starý nosí už desať rokov.
sentences.en: Zuzana needs a new coat, because she has been wearing the old one for ten years.

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň, môžem vám pomôcť?
sentences.en: Hello, can I help you?

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň. Chcela by som zimný kabát, najradšej modrý.
sentences.en: Hello. I would like a winter coat, blue if possible.

sentences.sk: Máme ich niekoľko. Hneď vám ich prinesiem.
sentences.en: We have several. I'll bring them right away.

sentences.sk: Predavačka jej prinesie tri modré kabáty.
sentences.en: The saleswoman brings her three blue coats.

sentences.sk: Prvý je príliš krátky, druhý je príliš veľký a tretí stojí dvesto eur.
sentences.en: The first one is too short, the second is too big, and the third costs two hundred euros.

sentences.sk: Dvesto eur? To je veľmi drahé.
sentences.en: Two hundred euros? That's very expensive.

sentences.sk: Mohli by ste mi ukázať niečo lacnejšie?
sentences.en: Could you show me something cheaper?

sentences.sk: Ten druhý je v zľave. Stojí len päťdesiat eur.
sentences.en: The second one is on sale. It costs only fifty euros.

sentences.sk: Zuzana si kabát oblečie a pozerá sa do zrkadla.
sentences.en: Zuzana puts on the coat and looks in the mirror.

sentences.sk: Marek, ako vyzerám?
sentences.en: Marek, how do I look?

sentences.sk: Pekne, ale rukávy sú trochu dlhé.
sentences.en: Nice, but the sleeves are a bit long.

sentences.sk: Máte ho aj v menšej veľkosti?
sentences.en: Do you have it in a smaller size too?

sentences.sk: Bohužiaľ nie. Máme už len dva kusy, oba veľké.
sentences.en: Unfortunately not. We only have two left, both large.

sentences.sk: Kým Zuzana rozmýšľa, Marek skúša košele.
sentences.en: While Zuzana is thinking, Marek tries on shirts.

sentences.sk: Pozri, tieto dve košele by som si kúpil.
sentences.en: Look, I would buy these two shirts.

sentences.sk: A tieto čierne nohavice mi tiež sedia.
sentences.en: And these black pants fit me too.

sentences.sk: Prišli sme kúpiť kabát pre mňa, nie oblečenie pre teba!
sentences.en: We came to buy a coat for me, not clothes for you!

sentences.sk: Viete čo? Ten starý kabát by som mohla nosiť ešte jednu zimu.
sentences.en: You know what? I could wear the old coat for one more winter.

sentences.sk: A nechceli by ste aspoň novú čiapku? Je na ňu zľava.
sentences.en: And wouldn't you like a new hat, at least? It's on sale.

sentences.sk: Dobre, zoberiem si jednu modrú čiapku.
sentences.en: Okay, I'll take one blue hat.

sentences.sk: Pri pokladni platia spolu deväťdesiat eur.
sentences.en: At the register they pay ninety euros altogether.

sentences.sk: Domov idú s dvoma košeľami, jedným párom nohavíc a modrou čiapkou.
sentences.en: They go home with two shirts, one pair of pants and a blue hat.

questions.q: Prečo si Zuzana nekúpi lacný kabát?

recap: Zuzana goes shopping for a blue winter coat, but one is too short, one too expensive and the cheap one too big. She decides to keep her old coat and buys only a blue hat, while Marek goes home with two shirts and a pair of pants.
